_comment: Internal faults hidden until tested. part: specific part id, or 'battery'/'keys' to resolve from the model, or 'ram'/'storage' to resolve by type, or 'psu'/'fan'/'board'/'server_ear' from the model's *_part fields. types = hardware it can affect (model type or tag); omitted = all. weight = relative frequency. visible_condition links a fault to an external cosmetic tag (so it shows on hover AND in the test report).
